current_case_binding.interpretation: The labels remain the frozen AI-reviewed silver judgments. Current evaluation uses exact content-derived chunk IDs where available. A missing ID may bind only to one row at the same paper, encoded chunk index, page interval, and section when the persisted bounded excerpt is byte-for-byte unchanged and the row belongs to the active dense corpus. The frozen and current corpus identities remain distinct; this is current-snapshot scoring, not exact reproduction or relabeling of the historical snapshot.
